stories.title: France-Italie : soirée frustrante pour les Bleus, malgré le retour triomphal de Zidane au Stade de France

en.title: France-Italy: frustrating evening for the Blues, despite Zidane's triumphant return to the Stade de France
en.summary: France drew 1-1 with Italy in a Nations League match. The result disappointed supporters who hoped to celebrate the new coach's first home game with a victory.

stories.title: Ebola en RDC : la pire épidémie de l’histoire du pays franchit la barre des 4 000 morts

en.title: Ebola in DRC: the country's worst epidemic crosses the 4,000 death threshold
en.summary: The Democratic Republic of Congo faces an unprecedented Ebola outbreak that has killed over 4,000 people. Armed groups and local distrust complicate response efforts, as France's foreign affairs minister visits to demonstrate Paris's support.

stories.title: L’équipe de France concède le match nul contre l’Italie pour la première de Zinédine Zidane au Stade de France comme sélectionneur

en.title: France draws with Italy in Zinédine Zidane's first match as coach at the Stade de France
en.summary: France scored first but conceded an equalizer to Italy after a defensive error during a Nations League match on Friday, resulting in a draw in Zidane's home debut as national team coach.

stories.title: 🔴 Ligue des nations : les Bleus tenus en échec par l'Italie pour la première de Zidane à domicile

en.title: Nations League: France held to a draw by Italy in Zidane's home debut
en.summary: France drew with Italy in a Nations League match during Zinédine Zidane's first game as coach at home.

stories.title: Pour "faire baisser les prix" des carburants, les pays du G7 vont libérer "jusqu'à 100 millions de barils" sous quatre mois, annonce Emmanuel Macron

en.title: To "lower fuel prices", G7 countries will release "up to 100 million barrels" within four months, announces Emmanuel Macron
en.summary: G7 nations plan to release up to 100 million barrels of oil over four months to reduce fuel prices, with Donald Trump endorsing Europe's decision to tap strategic reserves.

stories.title: En République du Congo, l'épidémie d'Ebola franchit le cap des 4 000 morts

en.title: In the Republic of Congo, the Ebola epidemic crosses the 4,000 death threshold
en.summary: The Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 4,000 deaths. France's foreign affairs minister is visiting the country to show French support for local authorities.

stories.title: Un Britannique inculpé pour préparation d'acte de terrorisme contre le leader d'extrême droite Nigel Farage

en.title: A British man charged with preparing terrorist act against far-right leader Nigel Farage
en.summary: A British individual has been charged with preparing a terrorist attack targeting far-right politician Nigel Farage. The same person is already facing prosecution for murdering a former Conservative MP.

stories.title: Sous la pression de Donald Trump, le G7 annonce un déblocage de 100 millions de barils de pétrole

en.title: Under pressure from Donald Trump, G7 announces release of 100 million barrels of oil
en.summary: The G7 announced the release of 100 million barrels of oil following pressure from Donald Trump. The move was prompted by threats of a U.S. embargo on diesel exports aimed at controlling rising fuel prices.

stories.title: Fermeture des lycées : pour les profs, «l’éducation nationale est la plus grande enseigne de bricolage du pays»

en.title: School closures: for teachers, "the education ministry is the country's largest DIY shop"
en.summary: Around 400 secondary schools closed on October 2 due to student protests. Teachers reported improvised remote learning hampered by lack of planning, inadequate digital tools, and mobilization difficulties.

stories.title: En Espagne, les députés rejettent des textes sur le logement proposés par le gouvernement en réponse à un mouvement de contestation

en.title: In Spain, deputies reject housing texts proposed by the government in response to a protest movement
en.summary: Spanish parliamentarians rejected housing proposals from the socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez's government. The rejection represents a setback and may lead to an escalation of the protest movement.

stories.title: RDC : l’épidémie d’Ebola franchit le cap des 4 000 morts

en.title: DRC: Ebola epidemic crosses 4,000 deaths
en.summary: The Democratic Republic of Congo is experiencing its worst Ebola outbreak in history, with over 4,000 deaths since mid-May. The country has recorded around 8,000 confirmed cases since the start of this seventeenth wave.

stories.title: Espagne : Camouflet pour Sanchez, les décrets sur le logement rejetés par les députés

en.title: Spain: Setback for Sanchez as housing decrees rejected by lawmakers
en.summary: Spain's government under Pedro Sánchez faced parliamentary defeat when measures addressing the housing crisis, including tenant protections and rent freezes, were rejected. The minority government, dependent on coalition partners including the Catalan party Junts, suffered the loss as key allies voted against the main decree.

stories.title: F-16 ukrainiens : le démenti ferme de Sabena Engineering et de l’Ukraine

en.title: Ukrainian F-16s: firm denial from Sabena Engineering and Ukraine
en.summary: Sabena Engineering, Belgium, and Ukraine have rejected reports from the Wall Street Journal claiming low availability of Ukrainian F-16 fighter jets due to extended maintenance delays.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : quels sont les efforts demandés aux retraités ?

en.title: 2027 Budget: what efforts are requested from retirees?
en.summary: The government's 2027 budget targets 5.5 billion euros in pension savings. The report examines what measures retirees must accept to achieve these cost reductions.

stories.title: Les organisations lycéennes appellent à poursuivre la mobilisation faute « de mesures concrètes »

en.title: Student organizations call for continued mobilization due to lack of concrete measures
en.summary: High school and student organizations have rejected proposals from Education Minister Édouard Geffray, citing insufficient concrete measures to address their concerns.

stories.title: Emploi américain : pourquoi une statistique décevante a fait grimper les Bourses

en.title: US employment: why disappointing statistics boosted stock markets
en.summary: Weak September job creation of 29,000 versus 85,000 expected led investors to lower expectations for Federal Reserve rate increases, with oil decline reinforcing this outlook. France's bond spread with Germany hit its highest level since 2012.

stories.title: Airbus à pleine cadence à Toulouse pour livrer à Eutelsat les satellites de la constellation OneWeb

en.title: Airbus at full capacity in Toulouse to deliver OneWeb constellation satellites to Eutelsat
en.summary: Airbus has delivered a first batch of 32 next-generation OneWeb satellites to operator Eutelsat. The European manufacturer can now produce nearly one satellite per day using a semi-automated assembly line.
